title: Special Executive Master Programme in Digital Marketing
description: Elevate your career with the Special Executive Master Programme (SEMP) in Digital Marketing, designed to transform you into a digital marketing strategist with cutting-edge skills and insights.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and Rushford Business School
longDescription: The Special Executive Master Programme (SEMP) in Digital Marketing equips professionals with advanced digital marketing strategies and tools to drive business growth. This comprehensive course covers SEO, social media, content marketing, and data analytics, preparing participants to excel in the dynamic digital landscape. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The Special Executive Master Programme in Digital Marketing allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The program effectively prepares learners to tackle complex operational challenges by integrating theoretical knowledge with practical applications.
courseDetails: The aim of the Special Executive Master Programme (SEMP) in Digital Marketing is to empower professionals with the knowledge and skills needed to navigate and excel in the rapidly evolving digital marketing industry. Through practical insights and strategic approaches, participants will gain a competitive edge and drive impactful digital marketing campaigns. Course Details: Performance Marketing Affiliate and Email: Explore the intricacies of leveraging affiliate partnerships and email campaigns to drive digital marketing performance. Performance Marketing Search and Social: Delve into the strategies and tactics for optimizing search engine and social media platforms to achieve performance marketing objectives. Data Analytics and Strategies: Gain insights into the utilization of data analytics to inform and refine digital marketing strategies for enhanced performance. Consumer Behavior: Understand the psychology and dynamics behind consumer behaviour in digital spaces to tailor marketing efforts effectively. Research Methodology: Learn the fundamental research methods and techniques essential for conducting data-driven analysis and market research in digital marketing. Current Issues in Marketing: Critically examine current issues in the field to stay updated with the latest trends, challenges, and innovations shaping the digital marketing landscape. Assessment: GP Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project(GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in digital marketing and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

modules.title: PERFORMANCE MARKETING - AFFILIATE AND MAIL
modules.summary: Module Aim The Performance Marketing - Affiliate and Mail module delves into the strategic intricacies of leveraging affiliate partnerships and email marketing to drive impactful results in the digital landscape. Participants explore the dynamics of affiliate marketing, learning to cultivate and manage partnerships effectively to expand reach and enhance conversions. Additionally, the module covers the nuances of email marketing strategies, emphasizing the creation of engaging content and automation techniques for effective audience engagement and conversion optimization. Through a blend of theoretical concepts and practical case studies, learners gain insights into harnessing data analytics and segmentation to maximize the performance of affiliate and email marketing campaigns, delivering tangible results for businesses.

modules.title: PERFORMANCE MARKETING - SEARCH AND SOCIAL
modules.summary: The Performance Marketing - Search and Social module immerses learners in the dynamic realm of digital advertising, focusing on leveraging the power of search engines and social media platforms. Participants delve into the intricacies of targeted advertising, mastering the art of crafting compelling ad campaigns tailored to specific audiences. Through a blend of theoretical concepts and practical hands-on experience, the module covers advanced techniques in keyword optimization, ad bidding strategies, and audience segmentation. Emphasis is placed on analyzing campaign metrics to optimize ROI, harnessing the potential of data-driven decision-making in maximizing marketing performance. Ultimately, participants acquire the skills needed to navigate the evolving landscapes of search engine and social media advertising, driving impactful results for businesses.

modules.title: Data Analytics And Strategies
modules.summary: The Data Analytics and Strategies module offers a comprehensive exploration of the tools, methodologies, and theories underpinning effective data analysis. It delves into the intricacies of data collection, processing, and interpretation, empowering learners to derive actionable insights from complex datasets. Through practical case studies and hands-on exercises, students develop proficiency in employing statistical techniques and data visualization to inform strategic decision-making. The module emphasizes the integration of cutting-edge technologies like machine learning and predictive modeling to drive informed business strategies. By focusing on real-world applications, it equips participants with the skills to navigate the evolving landscape of data-driven decision-making across diverse industries.

modules.title: CONSUMER BEHAVIOUR
modules.summary: Module Aim The Consumer Behavior module delves deep into understanding the psychology and decision-making processes that drive consumer actions in the marketplace. It explores the intricate interplay between consumer perceptions, motivations, and purchasing behaviors through psychological, sociological, and economic lenses. Participants examine the influence of culture, demographics, and social factors on consumer choices, gaining insights into how these elements shape buying patterns. By analyzing case studies and behavioral models, learners acquire a comprehensive understanding of consumer decision-making, enabling them to formulate effective marketing strategies tailored to diverse consumer segments. Ultimately, the module equips students with the tools to anticipate, interpret, and influence consumer behavior in a rapidly evolving market landscape.

modules.title: Current Issues In Marketing
modules.summary: Module Aim This seminar aims to provide participants with an in-depth understanding of current issues and trends in the marketing field to help them stay informed and up-to-date with the latest developments in the industry. The seminar aims to give participants the knowledge and skills they need to stay competitive in the ever-changing marketing landscape and to help them make informed decisions about their marketing strategies.

modules.title: Research Methodology
modules.summary: Module Aim The course is designed to help students become good researchers, to become familiar with the steps in proposing research topics, and clearly apply research knowledge in education. After completing the course, students will be able to prepare a research plan, collect data, address research questions and hypotheses, and organize a project report. Learning Outcomes Be able to formulate a research proposal relating to strategic business development Be able to use different research methodologies to gather sufficient and valid data Be able to present research findings in an appropriate format for a target audience Be able to evaluate own skills while undertaking research
